p.src: 1  The earth is the LORD’s, with its fullness; the world, and those who dwell in it.

en: The earth is the LORD’s, with its fullness; the world, and those who dwell in it.
u.src: 1  The earth is the LORD’s, with its fullness; the world, and those who dwell in it.

p.src: 2  For he has founded it on the seas, and established it on the floods.

en: For he has founded it on the seas, and established it on the floods.
u.src: 2  For he has founded it on the seas, and established it on the floods.

p.src: 3  Who may ascend to the LORD’s hill? Who may stand in his holy place?

ja: ることができるだろうか。 誰がその
つことができるだろうか。
en: Who may ascend to the LORD’s hill? Who may stand in his holy place?
u.src: 3  Who may ascend to the LORD’s hill? Who may stand in his holy place?

p.src: 4  He who has clean hands and a pure heart; who has not lifted up his soul to falsehood, and has not sworn deceitfully.

ja: が純粋な者。 その魂を偽りに
en: He who has clean hands and a pure heart; who has not lifted up his soul to falsehood, and has not sworn deceitfully.
u.src: 4  He who has clean hands and a pure heart; who has not lifted up his soul to falsehood, and has not sworn deceitfully.

p.src: 5  He shall receive a blessing from the LORD, righteousness from the God of his salvation.

en: He shall receive a blessing from the LORD, righteousness from the God of his salvation.
u.src: 5  He shall receive a blessing from the LORD, righteousness from the God of his salvation.

p.src: 6  This is the generation of those who seek Him, who seek your face—even Jacob. Selah.

ja: める者たち、すなわちヤコブである。 セラ。
en: This is the generation of those who seek Him, who seek your face—even Jacob. Selah.
u.src: 6  This is the generation of those who seek Him, who seek your face—even Jacob. Selah.

p.src: 7  Lift up your heads, you gates! Be lifted up, you everlasting doors, and the King of glory will come in.

en: Lift up your heads, you gates! Be lifted up, you everlasting doors, and the King of glory will come in.
u.src: 7  Lift up your heads, you gates! Be lifted up, you everlasting doors, and the King of glory will come in.

p.src: 8  Who is the King of glory? The LORD strong and mighty, the LORD mighty in battle.

en: Who is the King of glory? The LORD strong and mighty, the LORD mighty in battle.
u.src: 8  Who is the King of glory? The LORD strong and mighty, the LORD mighty in battle.

p.src: 9  Lift up your heads, you gates; yes, lift them up, you everlasting doors, and the King of glory will come in.

en: Lift up your heads, you gates; yes, lift them up, you everlasting doors, and the King of glory will come in.
u.src: 9  Lift up your heads, you gates; yes, lift them up, you everlasting doors, and the King of glory will come in.

p.src: 10  Who is this King of glory? The LORD of Armies is the King of glory! Selah.

en: Who is this King of glory? The LORD of Armies is the King of glory! Selah.
u.src: 10  Who is this King of glory? The LORD of Armies is the King of glory! Selah.
